description: This file defines a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'. It includes logic for parsing currency strings, applying filters, and merging data from multiple sources to produce a summarized report.

methods.name: toNumberSafe

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
